description.p: RDP Session Manager is a GTK4 application for GNOME that makes it easy to create, manage, and monitor RDP sessions.

ul.li: Modern graphical interface built with GTK4
Support for multiple desktop environments (GNOME, XFCE, KDE)

description.p: Adds multi-connection sources support, GTK4 fullscreen interactive login session launcher, and complete CLI profile management commands.
Adds full RemoteApp support and automated E2E testing for Snap and Flatpak applications.
Fixes installation, environment variables, and graphical desktop execution for XFCE, GNOME, and KDE Plasma over RDP.
Keeps sudo authentication visible and reliable when installing from headless terminals.
Adds real end-to-end validation that authenticates and renders an XFCE desktop through xrdp and FreeRDP.
Adds real installation checks across supported Linux distributions and validates public release assets before promotion.
Moves the installer and application interface to English throughout.
Simplifies distribution into a bootstrap and a verified bundle containing the supported packages.
Fixes interactive autoinstaller input when run through the curl pipe bash command.
Fixes autoinstaller checksum validation and strengthens release artifact tests.
Introduces a renewed cross-platform installer with progress, logs, and improved Arch and Ubuntu/Debian support.
Initial release of RDP Session Manager
